name: debounce-reset
diff:
diff --git a/src/search.js b/src/search.js
--- a/src/search.js
+++ b/src/search.js
@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
-export function onType(query) {
-  search(query)
+let timer
+export function onType(query) {
+  clearTimeout(timer)
+  timer = setTimeout(() => search(query), 300)
 }

question.prompt: A user types five letters quickly, 100 ms apart, then stops. How many times does search run, with which query, and why?
question.answerKey: Once, 300 ms after the last key, with the full five-letter query. Each keystroke clears the pending timer, so only the last one fires.
rubric: search runs once, with the final query
each keystroke clears the previous timer

answers.text: Just once, with all five letters, because every keypress cancels the previous timeout and only the last timer survives.
one search for the whole word, 300ms after typing stops, since clearTimeout resets it each time
Five times, once per letter, each delayed by 300 ms.
Once, with only the first letter, because the timer starts on the first key.
